direction: Contemporary clean white / cyan / cobalt game illustration. Replaces vintage ornamented mode artwork only; banner layout retained.
source: Generated independently with image_gen for this project.

assets.label: 정규전
assets.subject: A dynamic fan of three fresh white playing cards, tilted slightly clockwise. One card face has one large clean coral-red diamond; the other two have bold cobalt-blue and sky-cyan card backs with a single simple geometric stripe. Crisp pristine cards, modest navy edge outlines, small cyan angular backing shape integrated behind the fan. No tiny decorative patterns. Visually substantial but simple.

assets.label: 단기전
assets.subject: A contemporary compact white-and-cyan stopwatch tilted slightly to the right, with a dark navy clean dial and one bold coral hand, beside one white playing card with a red diamond. A couple of short solid cyan speed slashes attached to the left give a quick-match feeling. No clock numerals, no lettering. Modern sporting equipment, NOT an hourglass or antique timepiece.

assets.label: 친구대전
assets.subject: Two modern white playing cards facing one another as a friendly versus symbol: left card with a bold coral heart and coral edge, right card with a bold cobalt spade and cyan edge. A tiny angular cyan meeting spark between them, not a lightning storm. Offset overlapping composition with clean two-tone depth. No bow or ribbon. Readable as a card duel at small sizes.

assets.label: AI대전
assets.subject: A compact modern training-bot bust, clean white shell with sky-cyan side panels, dark navy rounded rectangular visor with two simple bright blue eye lights, holding a single white playing card with a coral-red diamond. Small friendly expression but no blush or baby proportions. Contemporary clean game mascot equipment, no antenna pompom, no brass, no cogs, no winding key, no steampunk.
